what: Nordson makes precision dispensing equipment: the systems that apply exact amounts of adhesive, sealant, coating or solder in manufacturing, from packaging lines to electronics assembly, plus medical fluid components.
customers: Packaging and consumer goods manufacturers, electronics assemblers, medical device makers and industrial producers.
money: adhesive dispensing for packaging, nonwovens and industrial coating
medical tubing, balloons and fluid components
moat: Equipment that runs for decades and consumes its own nozzles, filters and parts, so the installed base generates recurring revenue at high margins.
risks: Industrial capital spending has been soft
Revenue grew only about 4% last year
Debt of about $1.8 billion against very little cash
opportunities: Operating margin of 25% with a 55% gross margin
Medical components grow faster and more steadily than industrial equipment
Parts and consumables are a large share of revenue and recur automatically
watch: Organic order growth and the medical segment's revenue share.
